title: 第13章 润人王强第14章 短板补齐身材变化
slug: 人在美利坚我的叔叔堂吉诃德
content_zh:
“你......你这是抢劫！”
等到李维走近一看，一个戴着四方黑框眼镜、身材有些发福走样的中年男人正用汉语激烈地向里昂控诉。
“王强先生，你先冷静一点，”里昂一边修着手指甲，一边慢条斯理地说道，“这个耳机新款已经出来很久了，你这个完全没有回收价值的。”
“但......这可是收藏款！”王强气得面红耳赤，但是又无可奈何，“我我我......我不卖了。”
“随意，请您自便。”
里昂冲王强摆了摆手，送客。
王强把柜台上的耳机装进怀里，扭头就走。
“天朝人？”他转过头来，看见李维点了点头之后低声说道，“别在他这里卖东西，他是个奸商。”
李维侧身让开位置，笑了笑没说话。
待王强走后，李维来到柜台面前，从兜里掏出4枚金币，一字摆开。
“我这里还有4枚金币，同样是纯金的，”李维一边说一边发动了【拙劣口才】，“这次的价格是不是还能再往上提一提？”
精神力比起上次1.0的时候提升了一大截，技能也升级了2次，李维有预感他这次应该能卖个比上次更好的价钱。
里昂则是盯着李维拿出来的金币一直看，不说话也不表态。
就在李维怀疑这次的技能是不是没有产生效果之时，他的脑海中终于传来了熟悉的“叮”的一声。
这时里昂才缓缓说道：“你说的对，这东西的收藏价值很高，回收的价格应该更高一些。”
“上次的回收价格是500美金一枚，”李维露出了一丝笑容，“这次你最高能给多少钱？”
...
等到李维心满意足的从回收店里出来的时候，他刚好看到王强正蹲在路边抽烟，一脸愁闷的模样。
“小伙子，”王强看到李维几分钟就走了出来，拍了拍屁股站起来，语重心长的说道，“我都跟你说了，那个法国老头最喜欢坑我们这些华人，你怎么还去他那边卖东西呢？”
“还行吧，”李维没跟他说他把价值1600美金的4枚金币卖出了3000美金的价格，“我也只是偶尔来一趟。”

“唉......你们这些年轻人，”王强见李维衣着朴素的样子，推了推眼镜，“看你面生，刚来没多久吧？来这边读书？”
李维点了点头，没有多说些什么。
老乡见老乡，背后开一枪，他现在先不打算透露自己的个人信息。
“我儿子也跟你差不多大，在富兰克林高中念书，不过他刚来没多久，英语成绩比较差，还得补语言班，好在我爱人的英语还不错，”王强说道，“对了，我看你也不像是什么坏孩子，你住哪儿？要是也在这附近读书的话，可以让我家浩然跟你有个照应。”
“我住日落公园那边，”李维随意地说了一个大概范围，“我跟我亲戚住在一起。”
content_en:
"You...you are robbing!"
When Levi came closer, he saw a middle-aged man wearing square black-rimmed glasses and a somewhat fat and out-of-shape figure, complaining fiercely to Lyon in Chinese.
"Mr. Wang Qiang, please calm down first," Leon said slowly while trimming his fingernails, "This new model of headphones has been out for a long time, and you have absolutely no recycling value."
"But... this is a collector's item!" Wang Qiang blushed with anger, but he had no choice but to say, "I, I, I... I won't sell it."
"Whatever, please do it yourself."
Leon waved to Wang Qiang to see the guest off.
Wang Qiang put the headphones on the counter into his arms, turned around and left.
"Chinese people?" He turned around, saw Li Wei nodded and whispered, "Don't sell things here, he is a profiteer."
Levi stepped aside to get out of the way, smiled and said nothing.
After Wang Qiang left, Li Wei came to the counter, took out 4 gold coins from his pocket, and spread them out.
"I still have 4 gold coins here, which are also pure gold," Levi said while activating [Poor Eloquence], "Can the price be raised this time?"
His mental power has improved a lot compared to the last time in 1.0, and his skills have been upgraded twice. Levi has a hunch that he should be able to sell it at a better price this time than last time.
Leon stared at the gold coins that Levi took out without saying anything or expressing his position.
Just when Levi was wondering if this skill had no effect, a familiar "ding" sound finally came from his mind.
At this time, Leon slowly said: "You are right, this thing has a high collection value, and the recycling price should be higher."
"The last recycling price was 500 US dollars per piece," Levi showed a smile, "How much is the highest price you can give this time?"
...
When Li Wei came out of the recycling store satisfied, he happened to see Wang Qiang squatting on the roadside smoking, with a depressed look on his face.
"Young man," Wang Qiang saw Li Wei walking out within a few minutes, patted his butt and stood up, saying earnestly, "I've told you, that old French man likes to trick us Chinese the most, why are you still going to sell things to him?"
"It's okay," Levi didn't tell him that he sold four gold coins worth $1,600 for $3,000. "I only come here occasionally."
"Oh... you young people," Wang Qiang saw Li Wei's plain clothes and pushed up his glasses, "You look unfamiliar, you just came here not long ago, right? Are you here to study?"
Levi nodded and said nothing more.
When a fellow villager meets a fellow villager, he shoots him in the back. He is not going to reveal his personal information now.
"My son is about the same age as you and is studying at Franklin High School. However, he just came here and his English scores are relatively poor and he has to take language classes. Fortunately, my wife's English is not bad," Wang Qiang said, "By the way, I don't think you are a bad boy. Where do you live? If you are also studying here, you can let my family, Haoran, take care of you."
"I live over in Sunset Park," Levi said casually, giving a general idea. "I live with my relatives."
